source_evidence: Exact player 'ok continue the journey' authorizes ordinary remaining overnight and continuation toward the previously chosen ruins, not a new discretionary expense or combat action. D330 after~22:10 no additional disturbance and a full qualifying wilderness night occurs by~06:30 D331; no extra occurrence roll because D330 encounter used. All pools already full, no Psi Recovery/Second Wind/HD expense. LR1→2/6, no full Long Rest. Routine dawn Tamsin contact per standing instructions, no specific estate result or other message receipt inferred. D331 morning Mara inspects actual track and wheel clearance before driving: this segment is a rough local supply cartway, rutted and slow but sufficiently wide/firm for the existing coach and team at careful walking pace, with room to halt; no guarantee beyond inspected section, no hired guide, paid staging, purchase or forced march. Party travels together on difficult ground toward western crossing. Predeclared leg cap2 encounter days, prior1 used; remote wilderness track day1–40, local monster table wolves/giant boars/owlbears. Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt batch d29d1226fcdbe80c1f3fe4b6d9fdf750 d100 occurrence9, type56 dangerous humanoids; independent hill-country hostile hunting group, not earlier abductors; user-visible severity receipt d182b8e4cdf3c0d16baf92ae37ff5d99 d100 face17 manageable. DM fixes finite five MM2014 Gnolls (CR1/2, AC15, HP22 each, 500 base/1000 adjusted XP for three combat PCs) hunting the hill country for meat, aggressive and opportunistic, no faction/ancestry/kidnapper connection. At~11:00 after roughly5 of12 rough miles, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar with healthy coach/four horses halt when Fenar spots hyena-headed figures emerging among rocks and brush. They have spotted the approaching coach in daylight, barking calls and lifting weapons; one visibly nocks an arrow without firing. Center of gnoll group approximately100ft ahead along trail, spread across ~35ft: two with bows on low rocky rise~5ft above road on right, three at trail verge and left scrub, weapons ready; cover available behind rocks/trunks where applicable, no automatic surprise, attacks, forced movement, exact tactical squares or initiative rolled. Road locally wide enough for stopped coach; space behind party to turn back along traveled track, no guaranteed safe bypass. Mara holds reins near coach; companions ready, V decides response. No food/feed deduction for incomplete D331 travel day, no new charge, no resource use, no damage or completed arrival. D331 occurrence consumes second of2 allowed random encounter days for this three-day leg, no additional night roll this day. No actual combat before initiative and scoped statblock verification.
